baseline.runtimeNote: Only isolated test dependencies changed package/lock files. All baseline core source members used by the comparison verify against supplied source hashes. Benchmark build resolves shared packages through its own pinned tree.

factoryQA.officialPeers: Both Vue and React retain Core node, edited value Kept and DOM for the literal Schema replacement; both produce real SVGSVGElement and SVGPathElement on the valid array-child schema.

patches.behavior: Mark the built-in FormKit factory and project ordinary literal FormKit props into the native schema owner map. Retain fields and edited values on Schema/memo replacement. Preserve own/non-enumerable prop getters and expression/loop scopes. Custom factories remain opaque.
patches.limits: Expression-bound whole prop bags, bind declarations, overridden factories and opaque provider-containing sibling scopes retain their existing factory lifecycle; arbitrary replacement of opaque private component state is not claimed.

patches.behavior: Create SVG elements with the SVG namespace, inherit that namespace below SVG parents, and resume HTML below foreignObject. Basic nested SVG/path browser case verified; no blanket XML/MathML support claim.

inputTimingValidity: INVALIDATED by independent missing capture:true audit;corrected harness/evidence is owned by licensed browser task. No input timing or post-fix timing claim accepted here.

retentionFindings.fiftyCycleStudy: All arms reached zero live owned Core nodes/controls on each destroy. Mixed Pro numeric heap, DOM and listener counters nevertheless grow; no leak-free claim. Native control follow-up shows zero DOM growth.
retentionFindings.transferlist: Five isolated transferlist mounts add five document mousemove callbacks in every binding; native text adds none. Same generated callback source-maps to official @formkit/pro/index.mjs line48 column27983. Function behavior uses transferlist hover coordinates and registers a document listener; no licensed source is reproduced. Removing transferlist eliminates this callback growth but not all mixed-form DOM retention.
retentionFindings.colorpicker: Three isolated colorpicker mounts retain detached DOM in all three bindings after explicit GC and a two-second wait: adapter +201 nodes, Vue +81, React +33. Core creation/destruction balances. This is a separate retention finding; no definitive retaining path without additional analysis. Do not revert subtree-ancestry cleanup blindly: earlier actual Pro canvas teardown failures motivated it.
retentionFindings.other: Individual adapter-only family isolation shows zero retained DOM growth for the other twelve families in this three-cycle fixture, except transferlist +6. Repeater/taglist listener counters also increase without DOM growth; not fully attributed. Small fixed securitypolicyviolation instrumentation listener can appear after Pro initialization.
retentionFindings.debuggerCaveat: First broad retention follow-up did not explicitly release individual listener remote handles. Do not use its delayed-GC result alone. Dedicated transferlist, colorpicker, ablation and individual-family probes explicitly release those handles; original fifty-cycle study has no global-listener debugger handles.
retentionFindings.recommendedAction: Keep Pro transferlist retention as an upstream package issue pending a supported disposer/fix. No global event monkeypatch, licensed-source modification or upstream post was made. Colorpicker retaining path remains open.

profiling.scope: Separate CPU profiles of twelve mixed-form updates/resets, three warmups; not latency samples or full lifecycle CPU.
profiling.observed: Adapter section-renderer sampled self CPU ~91.9ms, including read(path) ~27.7ms and dependency checks/attributes. This identifies a potential optimization area, not evidence that guards can safely be removed.
profiling.proposal: Preserve dependency/bag mutation checks. A separately controlled path-resolution optimization could be evaluated later; no speculative cache, guard removal or benchmark-only fast path added.
profiling.additionalConcreteInefficiency: Changing both Schema library and memo in one update causes two presentation rebuilds in the current public fixture (destroy callback count2). Native owners retain identity. Transactional component-prop updates are worth a focused correctness/efficiency follow-up; no unmeasured runtime rewrite included.
profiling.mapping: Source maps omit sourcesContent. Supplied analysis maps sampled self locations, keeps idle/program/GC separate. FormKit package category includes the binding packages; it is not entirely common Core work.

knownLimits: Pro incremental native mask typing and colorpicker ARIA attribute issue were reproduced in official React in prior task runs; no blanket mask editing/a11y parity claim.
No real camera access, permission grant, Mac work, production writes, merge, publishing, key copying or security changes.
Parent is integrating newer lazy exception/reverse-inheritance fixes. Those future changes are excluded from this exact-snapshot study and should be validated separately.
currentSourceBoundary: The supplied4-file patch was reconciled with additional provider/slot fixes;its isolated19/19 QA and baseline performance do not attest current combined source.
